name: rag_retrieval
objective: Evaluate whether the running knowledge base retrieves chunks that actually contain the answer, so that chunking strategy changes can be compared instead of guessed at.

book_hit_rate.description: Hit rate restricted to questions answered by the PDF book.

video_hit_rate.description: Hit rate restricted to questions only the Bilibili subtitle answers. Guards against the video being drowned out, since it is roughly 6% of the index.

hit_rate_at_1.description: Questions where the very first retrieved chunk is already correct. hit@5 saturates on a small corpus; this is the metric that can actually detect an improvement in chunk granularity.

pinpoint_hit_rate_at_1.description: hit@1 restricted to pinpoint factual questions, which are most sensitive to chunk size because a large chunk buries the specific number inside a long passage.

hit_rate_at_k.description: Questions where at least one of the top-k chunks is correct. k is src.runtime.rag.DEFAULT_TOP_K, the same value production uses, so this measures the real configuration.

mrr_at_k.description: Mean reciprocal rank of the first correct chunk within top-k.

pinpoint_hit_rate_at_k.description: hit@k restricted to pinpoint factual questions.

category_filter_correctness.description: Fraction of category-filter cases producing the exact expected chunk set. The dangerous failure is over-filtering to empty: retrieval would silently stop working and look like 'nothing in the knowledge base', so an unknown or unmatched category must fall back to the full set rather than return nothing.

constraints: This suite must hit the real retrieval path: real embedding call for the query, real index for candidates.
Skip the suite instead of failing it when chunks.json or embeddings.json is missing.
Report whether retrieval ran in vector mode or fell back to keyword mode, because rag.py degrades silently.
Ground truth is keyword presence, not page numbers. Page numbers shift whenever chunking changes, and chunking is what this suite measures.
Thresholds are set just below the measured baseline so the suite acts as a regression guard, not an aspiration.
Judge must use src.runtime.rag.DEFAULT_TOP_K, not a hardcoded k. The judge previously hardcoded 5 while production used 3, which overstated coverage.
Category-filter cases use hand-built chunks, so they need no index and no embedding call.

baseline.chunking: 父块 1200 + 子块 700（CHILD_CHUNK_SIZE=700），145 父块 / 290 子向量
baseline.retrieval: NumPy 向量化，混合检索默认关闭
baseline.note: 此前 judge 写死 k=5 而生产用 k=3，报出的 hit_rate 和 video_hit_rate 都偏高一档。改为共用 rag.DEFAULT_TOP_K 后重新量得此基线。唯一失败用例 video_blood_volume 排第 4。

experiments.config: 单层块 145 个 × 1200 字符
experiments.verdict: 基准。定点题 hit@1 最高，推翻了「大块会稀释定点查询」的假设。

experiments.config: 父子块，子块 400 字符（585 子向量）
experiments.verdict: 明显更差。子块切太碎，丢失局部主题句；按父块取子块最高分等于在多个噪声估计里取最大值，放大假阳性。

experiments.config: 父子块，子块 700 字符（290 子向量）
experiments.verdict: 与单层块统计上打平：整体 hit@1 多命中 1 个用例，定点 hit@1 少命中 1 个。30 个用例分辨不出高下。选它是因为语料增长后子块粒度更有优势，而不是因为当前更好。

experiments.config: 混合检索 RRF 融合（向量 + 关键词 TF-IDF）
experiments.verdict: 更差，已默认关闭。等权时 hit@k 1.00→0.93、book_hit 1.00→0.91；向量权重加到 8:1 才回到纯向量水平，说明关键词的每一分贡献都是负的。结构性原因：纯向量已经饱和，融合只能把正确结果挤出去。代码和 RAG_HYBRID_ENABLED 开关保留，语料变大后可重新评估。
